glosses: to deal; to trade (to do business with)

examples.text: Dann muss jedes Unternehmen, das mit Firmen in der EU geschäftet, individuell nachweisen, dass es die europäischen Datenschutzstandards einhält. Sonst wird die EU intervenieren. Die Bürokratie dürfte immens werden.
examples.translation: Then every company doing business with the EU must prove separately that it adheres to European privacy standards. Else the EU will intervene. Bureaucracy will be immeasurable.
examples.english: Then every company doing business with the EU must prove separately that it adheres to European privacy standards. Else the EU will intervene. Bureaucracy will be immeasurable.

glosses: สัมปทานการก พหูพจน์ของ Geschäft
